c4_disclosure.statement: Exploratory values of the EXP-001 primary contrast (A1 minus A0 VCI) and of other contrasts were computed and printed before the freeze, on development seeds 1..40 only (J-0002, J-0003). No confirmatory seed (1001..1030) has been run. The amendments approved by the owner (A1 to A5) concern a degenerate cell, the seed count, optionality, the placebo match and documentation; A1 and A4 were informed by the pilot's flag counts and TF skip fraction, not by the primary contrast. Real-market reference values (J-0004) were computed on FI-2010 days 1..9 only; simulated pilot values of the same statistics exist in results/exploratory/*/summary.md and runs/, but no placement of simulated values against the reference was computed. The held-out day 10 was read for validity and segment counts only.
